transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because… people keep treating this foreclosure like it’s just paperwork, like I missed payments and that’s all. But it’s not that simple. The bank, the loan servicer… and some people at my job, I’m pretty sure they’ve been working together to push me out of my house. It’s been going on almost two years, and the papers they show me don’t change what I’ve seen.
Do you really believe that people at your job and the bank are working together against you?

Yes. I know how it sounds, but… yes. It’s not just missed payments. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job have been involved in this, quietly. They’ve been trying to push me out of my house, and I’ve been seeing it for almost two years. The papers don’t change that.
Have you experienced any other situations where you felt like people were plotting against you?

It’s mostly this. The foreclosure… the bank, the loan servicer, and some people at work. I don’t really want to get into every little thing, but it’s all connected. They act like it’s just missed payments, but I know what I’ve seen.
Do you think people are talking about you or plotting against you when you're not around?

Yes… I think they do. Not like everybody, but the bank people, the loan servicer, and some people at work. I can’t prove every conversation, but it feels like they’ve been coordinating things behind my back to push me out of my house. They keep acting like it’s just paperwork, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Do you think the people involved in the foreclosure are plotting against you in a way that's unusual or doesn't make sense to other people?

I mean… yes, I guess other people say it doesn’t make sense. But I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s not just paperwork or missed payments. The bank, the loan servicer… even people at my job, they’ve been working together quietly to push me out of my house. That’s why I’m here. No amount of papers they show me changes that.
How long have you believed that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you?
About… a year and nine months, I think. Since the foreclosure notices started coming and the bank calls were taking over things at home.
Have you ever considered the possibility that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job might not be working together against you?

I’ve… considered it because people keep telling me that. But no. I’m here because everyone acts like it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, and I know it’s more than that. The bank, the loan servicer, even people at my job… they’ve been working together quietly to push me out. Papers don’t change what I’ve been seeing.
Do you think the belief that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you is something that most people would understand and agree with?

No… most people don’t seem to agree with it. They keep saying it’s just paperwork and missed payments. But I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job… it’s like they’ve been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Papers don’t change that.
Have your beliefs about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you ever changed or wavered since you first started thinking they were plotting against you?

Not really. I mean… people show me papers and say it’s just missed payments, just foreclosure steps, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, even people at work… it’s been going on almost two years. I don’t think I’ve wavered on that.
Do you think the idea that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you is a strange or unusual belief to hold?

I guess other people might call it strange. I don’t see it that way. I’m here because everyone keeps acting like it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, but… I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, people at my job—they’ve been working together quietly to push me out of my house. It’s been almost two years, and papers don’t change that.
Do you think the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working against you in a way that's physically impossible or highly unlikely?

No… I don’t think it’s physically impossible. People can talk. Banks and servicers can coordinate, and people at work can… pass things along. I know everyone says it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, but I’ve been seeing this for almost two years. They’re working together to push me out, quietly. The papers don’t change that.
Do you think the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working against you in a way that is so strange or unbelievable that it couldn't possibly be true?

No. I mean… it’s not unbelievable to me. People keep saying it’s just paperwork and missed payments, but I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, even people at my job… they’ve been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Papers don’t change that.
Have you ever had any doubts about your belief that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you?

Not really. I mean, people keep telling me it’s just paperwork and missed payments, but… I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on too long for me to just doubt it because they show me more papers.
Do you think it's possible for you to change your mind about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you?

I don’t really see that happening. I’m here because everyone keeps treating it like it’s just foreclosure papers and missed payments, but I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the servicer… people at work too. They’ve been working together quietly to push me out, and more papers aren’t going to change that.
Have you ever had a period of time where you did not believe the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job were working together against you?
No… not really. Since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls started, it’s been like this. About… a year and nine months, I guess.
Do you think there's any evidence that could change your mind about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you?

No. I mean… they can keep showing me papers, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing. Everyone keeps acting like it’s just missed payments and foreclosure paperwork, but the bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job have been working together quietly. It’s been almost two years. So… no, I don’t think there’s evidence that would change my mind.

Is there anything that could happen or anything someone could tell you that would make you completely change your mind about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you?

No… I don’t think so. I know everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork and missed payments, but that’s not what it looks like to me. The bank, the servicer, even people at my job… they’ve been working together quietly to push me out of my house. I’ve been seeing it for almost two years, so I don’t think someone just telling me otherwise would change that.
Do you think you will ever be able to stop believing that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you?

No… I don’t think I’ll be able to just stop believing it. People keep saying it’s paperwork and missed payments, but that’s not what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at work… it feels like they’ve been working together to push me out of my house. It’s been too long for me to just let that go.
Do you think your belief about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you could ever be proven completely wrong?

No… I don’t think it could be proven completely wrong. They can show me papers and say it’s just missed payments, but that doesn’t change what I’ve seen. The bank, the loan servicer, people at my job… they’ve been working together quietly for almost two years. I know how it sounds, but I don’t think that just goes away.
